outcome: Association between formula feeding and other factors
cohort: 494 mothers with infants aged 0-6 months in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: Nearly half of the participants practiced formula-feeding for their infant, with educational status of mothers, the timing of initiation of breastfeeding, delivery by cesarean section, and pre-lacteal feeding practice being significantly associated with this practice.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was significantly associated with formula feeding practice.
